This can happen during app startup, for example in app root elements that are rendered before route resolution has been finalized. In that case `useRouteRef` returns `undefined` at first, and the component automatically re-renders with the resolved link generator once the app has been finalized. We then call the link generator, passing it an object with the kind, namespace, and name. These parameters are used to construct a concrete path to the "Foo" details page.`) — Keep the explanation that useRouteRef returns undefined if a route or its ancestors are not yet registered during startup and automatically updates once finalized.
